  WARNING   entry 0  Public key has a non-canonical encoding [key.noncanonical_spki]
            The public key is encoded differently from its canonical form, for example RSA without NULL parameters or a compressed EC point. Its x509-spki-sha256 identity uses the canonical form, so the as-encoded fingerprint differs and is shown separately. Some software rejects such encodings.
            Evidence: x509-spki-sha256=11af3f7072eedda181f42ca5312031b33c9c1011782af9028b5df3c5af23a469; x509-spki-encoded-sha256=edbaab3f420f0df805ae4ef0c8ef553b03a96f85158e2ac907359d35b0fabd55
            Fix: Reissue the certificate, or create a new certificate signing request, with a canonically encoded public key.
